# OPSQAI

> OPSQAI is a Windows Self-Hosted operational AI platform with licensed modules and custom workspaces, not simply a chatbot or document search tool.

OPSQAI connects company knowledge with operational work: training, internal requests, HR, fleet workflows, reports and role-based access. KAI is its conversational interface, not the whole product. Available domain products include HR, Transport, Logistics and Operations; other products may be planned and are labelled on the Platform page.

Custom development starts with Discovery: problem, diagnosis, solution design and workspace. Banking, financial services, auto repair, manufacturing and other businesses with suitable infrastructure are potential custom-development domains, not claims of existing deployments or ready-made products. Scope, integrations, hardware and value assumptions are established per engagement.

The customer's Windows installation holds operational data. A local AI engine is the default; external AI providers and integrations are optional and their data flows depend on configuration. Cloud services support licensing, releases, distribution and customer support; they are separate from the customer's operational installation. All modules remain license-governed. Roles and permissions govern user access within licensed capabilities.

Published research cites external sources. OPSQAI analyses and simulations are distinct from measured client outcomes. Estimates are not guaranteed savings; security controls are not a claim of legal compliance or certification.
